sloka: तस्मिन् प्रतिहते ऽस्त्रे तु राघवेण महात्मना ।रावणः क्रोधताम्राक्षः सौरमस्त्रमुदैरयत् ।। ६.१०१.६ ।।
transliteration: tasmin pratihate 'stre tu rāghaveṇa mahātmanā ।rāvaṇaḥ krodhatāmrākṣaḥ sauramastramudairayat ।। 6.101.6 ।।

translations.english: When the missile of Ravana was turned void by the great selfRaghava, Ravana's eyes turned red in anger, and he used a missile presided over by the Sun God.
